description_en: Configures the employees who can use a specified invoice title
description_zh: 配置发票抬头可用员工
name: InvoiceRuleSave

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the invoice title applies to all employees. Valid values: true and false. This parameter is deprecated. Use the new field scope instead
parameters.help_zh: 是否全员适用 是：true  否：false（已废除，取新字段scope）
parameters.name: all_employe

parameters.help_en: The applicable scope. Valid values: 1 (all employees), 2 (partial), 3 (disabled). Either scope or all_employe is required. If scope has a value, all_employe does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 适用范围：1-全员适用，2-部分适用，3-禁用（scope和all_employe二选一必填，当scope有值时，all_employe不生效）
parameters.name: scope

fields.help_en: The entity ID. Valid values: 1 (employee ID), 2 (internal business travel department ID), 3 (third-party department ID). This parameter is required when all_employe is set to false
fields.help_zh: 1：员工id，2：商旅内部部门id，3：三方部门id（all_employe为false时，entities里元素的id必传）
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The entity name. This parameter is required when all_employe is set to false
fields.help_zh: 实体名，all_employe为false时，entities里元素的name必传
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The entity type. Valid values: 1 (employee), 2 (internal business travel department), 3 (third-party department). This parameter is required when all_employe is set to false
fields.help_zh: 1：员工，2：商旅内部部门，3：三方部门（all_employe为false时，entities里元素的type必传）
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not required when all_employe is set to true. Otherwise, this parameter is required
parameters.name: entities

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the enterprise access credential operation. Add this parameter to the request header. In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数 由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

message.description_en: The remarks about the result, such as a description of the result
message.description_zh: 备注，结果的备注，如对结果的说明
message.title_en: 备注，结果的备注，如对结果的说明
message.title_zh: 备注，结果的备注，如对结果的说明

module.title_zh: 返回值，服务端返回，没有结果或发生异常都返回空

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

success.description_en: The success flag. Set by the server. The value is false when an exception occurs or the result is null
success.description_zh: 成功标识，由服务端设置，发生异常时为false。结果为null设置为false
success.title_en: 成功标识，由服务端设置，发生异常时为false。结果为null设置为false。
success.title_zh: 成功标识，由服务端设置，发生异常时为false。结果为null设置为false。
